_meta.purpose: The content-driven selection layer for a multi-step PROCESS / wizard. A process = a sequence of step frames, each: a progress indicator + the current step's header + content + a nav row; the last frame is a confirmation. To compose: split the task into ordered steps, map each step's content to a body block (a form fieldset, or summary rows for a review step), and render each step as its OWN frame with the progress indicator highlighting that step. NO prototyping — deliver static frames.
_meta.usage: Pick the best-fit body per step. Input steps reuse the FORM blocks (fieldsets/fields). A review/summary step uses summary rows. The final frame uses the confirmation block. Fill every placeholder with real content; never leave an empty control.
_meta.patternSource: Each `pattern` id resolves in process/block-patterns.json; each block id in process/blocks.json. Form field blocks are referenced from form/blocks.json (the step content is form-shaped).

progress.intent: Show where the user is in the flow — the current step of N.
progress.whenToUse: Top of every step frame. A composed STEPPER (numbered Badge markers + short labels, current step highlighted, earlier steps done) when the steps deserve names; a ProgressBar + 'Schritt X von Y' caption for a lighter/linear indicator. On the confirmation frame, show all-complete or drop it.

nav.intent: Move between steps: back to the previous, forward to the next / commit.
nav.whenToUse: Bottom of every input step frame. A spread row: 'Zurück' (ghost/outlined, left) + 'Weiter' (Brand, right). The last input step's primary commits (e.g. 'Zahlungspflichtig buchen'). The confirmation frame uses a single primary action instead.

input-step.intent: A step that collects data — the common wizard step.
input-step.whenToUse: Most steps. A step header (title + optional description) above a FORM fieldset (fields reused from the form catalog). One logical group of inputs per step.

review-step.intent: A summary/review step: show the entered data grouped, each with an 'Ändern' link back to its step.
review-step.whenToUse: The step before the commit, or a checkout summary. Grouped summary rows (label + value + 'Ändern' link) under section sub-headings.

confirmation.intent: Close the flow: a success confirmation after the commit.
confirmation.whenToUse: The final frame. A centered success block: a Successful-tinted icon/badge, a Heading ('Buchung bestätigt'), a short confirmation text (booking ref etc.), and a single primary action ('Zur Startseite' / 'Buchung ansehen'). No stepper/nav.

step-header.intent: The current step's title + optional one-line description.
step-header.whenToUse: Directly under the progress indicator on every input/review step. Heading (step title) + optional Body description, grouped at R−1.

summary-row.intent: One reviewed value: a label + its entered value + an 'Ändern' link.
summary-row.whenToUse: In a review step. A spread row: label+value on the left, an 'Ändern' Link on the right; rows separated by Dividers.
